analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 consecutive trading days. RSI remains in a neutral range at 49.8. MACD histogram has worsened from 2.1552 to -3.0774, signaling a bearish convergence. Volume ratio at 0.40 indicates subdued activity. No Higher Low pattern formed with the 5-day low at $338.15 and 20-day low at $338.15. Trading below SMA20 ($380.54) and SMA200 ($383.22) suggests potential weakening of medium to long-term trends. Weekly ADX at 11.1 indicates a non-trending phase. Overall, the lack of directional momentum and multiple weakening signals warrant a continued wait-and-see approach.
